sources.title: STABLE AUDIO 3 - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: ABSTRACT Stable Audio 3 is a family of fast latent diffusion models (small, medium, large) for variable-length audio generation and editing. Since our models can generate several minutes of audio, variable-length generations are key to avoid the cost of producing full-length generations for short sounds.
